title: 第337章 教资第336章 伺候
slug: 以下犯上徒弟着实貌美
lines: “啊啊啊，终于结束了！”
把最后一个宗门首领送走后，赵惊昼伸了大大的懒腰。
赵惊昼这一身懒腰伸得毫无形象，双臂高举，衣袍被拉扯着往上提，露出一截细白的腰身。
宋朝生站在她身侧，余光扫到那一抹白，眉头微微皱了一下，伸手将她的衣摆往下拽了拽。
赵惊昼低头看着他的手，又抬头看他，嘴角弯起一个促狭的弧度：“怎么，怕我着凉？”
宋朝生没有回答，只是收回手，端起茶杯抿了一口。
赵惊昼看着他微微泛红的耳尖，笑得眉眼弯弯，却没有再逗他，从椅子上站起身，活动了一下僵硬的脖颈，骨头发出咔咔的脆响。
“安芷，你等会去干啥？”
她转头看向还坐在椅子上的楚安芷。
楚安芷手里捧着通灵宝，头也没抬：“归涯让我们去他那吃饭。”
赵惊昼的眼睛瞬间亮了，连脖颈的僵硬都忘了。
就连被白恒、白鹤和莫离问的眼神都失去高光的白望舒都眼前一亮。
赵惊昼眼里的光几乎要溢出来，她快步走到楚安芷身边，探头去看她手里的通灵宝：“吃什么？他做什么了？有没有说？”
楚安芷被她连珠炮似的问题问得抬起头，对上赵惊昼那双写满期待的眼睛，沉默了片刻，然后慢慢开口:“没说。
只说了去他那吃饭。”
赵惊昼眼里的光黯淡了一瞬，但很快又亮了起来。
“没说就没说，反正他的手艺，做什么都好吃。”
她转身，衣袂在微风中翻飞，走了两步又停下，回头看向还坐在椅子上的众人。
“还愣着干什么？走啊。”
宋朝生跟在赵惊昼身侧，步伐沉稳，看着她衣袂翻飞的背影，嘴角弯起一个浅浅的弧度。
赵遇鹤和花无忧对视一眼，也跟了上去。
白望舒从角落里站起身，整理了一下衣袍，面无表情地跟上，但脚步比平时快了不少。
楚安芷走在最后面，通灵宝还握在手里，低着头又看了一眼那条消息。
「拒当牛马未」：谈完过来，满汉全席～
楚安芷看着那条消息，嘴角弯起一个极淡的弧度，将通灵宝收回袖中，抬脚跟上了前方已经走出一段距离的众人。
众人来到赵归涯府邸，便直奔归涯院。
推开院门的瞬间，一股浓郁的香气扑面而来。
不是那种刻意雕琢的、精雕细琢的香，是食材本身被火候激发出的、最本真的气息，混着灵木燃烧的烟火气，让人不自觉地咽了咽口水。
院中的石桌上已经摆满了碗碟。
清蒸的、红烧的、炖煮的、凉拌的，荤素搭配，色彩斑斓，每一道都冒着热气，在暮色中氤氲成一片朦胧的白雾。
桌中央还摆着一个不大的砂锅，盖子盖得严严实实，只有从锅盖缝隙中钻出的丝丝热气，勾着人的魂。
楚安芷嗅了嗅鼻子。
嗯？怎么有一股晚香玉和冰雾果酒味？
楚安芷循着那股香味望去，就见赵归涯坐在一旁美人榻上，左手拿着饲欲，对嘴吸上一口，吐出晚香玉味的紫粉色烟雾。
右手在一个浅粉色光屏上不知划拉什么，时不时蹙起眉，轻声说些什么。
在他旁边还放着一坛已经开封，喝了一半的冰雾果酒。
楚安芷看到这一幕，刚踏进院子的脚，默默收了回去。
“小芷？”
身后被撞到的封无痕，有些疑惑看着有些凝重的楚安芷。
“归涯在办公。”
封无痕顺着楚安芷的目光看过去，沉默了片刻，然后慢慢开口：“办公就办公，你退什么？”
“他皱眉了。”
封无痕：？
content_en:
"Ahhhh, it's finally over!"
After sending away the last sect leader, Zhao Jingzhou stretched himself greatly.
Zhao Jingzhou's body was stretched out in an imageless manner, his arms were raised high, and his robe was pulled up, revealing a thin white waist.
Song Chaosheng stood beside her. He caught sight of the white patch of white with his peripheral vision. He frowned slightly and stretched out his hand to pull down the hem of her clothes.
Zhao Jingzhou looked down at his hands, then looked up at him again, the corners of his mouth curved in a narrow arc: "What, are you afraid that I will catch a cold?"
Song Chaosheng didn't answer, he just retracted his hand, picked up the tea cup and took a sip.
Zhao Jingzhou looked at the tips of his slightly red ears and smiled with crooked eyebrows, but did not tease him anymore. He stood up from the chair and moved his stiff neck, making a crackling sound from the bones.
"An Zhi, what are you going to do later?"
She turned to look at Chu Anzhi, who was still sitting on the chair.
Chu Anzhi held the psychic treasure in her hand without raising her head: "Gui Ya asked us to go to his place for dinner."
Zhao Jingzhou's eyes lit up instantly, and he even forgot about the stiffness in his neck.
Even Bai Wangshu, whose eyes had lost their luster when asked by Bai Heng, Bai He and Li Moli, brightened up.
The light in Zhao Jingzhou's eyes almost overflowed. She walked quickly to Chu Anzhi and looked at the psychic treasure in her hand: "What are you eating? What did he do? Did you tell him?"
Chu Anzhi raised her head due to her barrage of questions, met Zhao Jingzhou's expectant eyes, was silent for a moment, and then slowly said: "I didn't say anything.
I just said that I would go to his place for dinner. "
The light in Zhao Jingzhou's eyes dimmed for a moment, but soon brightened again.
"If you don't say it, you won't say it. Anyway, with his craftsmanship, everything tastes delicious."
She turned around, her clothes fluttering in the breeze, took two steps and then stopped, looking back at the people still sitting on the chairs.
"What are you still doing? Let's go."
Song Chaosheng followed Zhao Jingzhou with a steady pace. Looking at her back with her clothes flying, the corners of his mouth curved in a slight arc.
Zhao Yuhe and Hua Wuyou looked at each other and followed.
Bai Wangshu stood up from the corner, straightened his robes, and followed expressionlessly, but his pace was much faster than usual.
Chu Anzhi walked at the back, still holding the psychic treasure in her hand, lowering her head and taking another look at the message.
"Refuse to be a cow and a horse": After talking, come over and let the Manchus and Han people sit down~
Chu Anzhi looked at the message, curved her mouth in a slight arc, put the psychic treasure back into her sleeve, raised her feet and followed the people who had walked some distance in front of her.
When everyone arrived at Zhao Guiya's residence, they went straight to Guiya Courtyard.
The moment he opened the courtyard door, a strong aroma hit his face.
It's not the kind of deliberately carved and carefully crafted aroma, but the most authentic aroma inspired by the fire of the ingredients themselves, mixed with the smoke of burning spiritual wood, making people swallow their saliva unconsciously.
The stone table in the courtyard was already filled with dishes.
Steamed, braised, stewed, cold, mixed with meat and vegetables, colorful, every dish is steaming, forming a hazy white mist in the dusk.
There is also a small casserole in the center of the table, with the lid tightly closed. Only the slightest trace of hot air coming out of the gap in the lid attracts people's soul.
Chu Anzhi sniffed her nose.
Um? Why does it smell like tuberose and ice-mist cider?
Chu Anzhi followed the scent and saw Zhao Guiya sitting on the beauty's couch beside him. He was holding a cup of wine in his left hand, taking a sip to his mouth and spitting out purple-pink smoke that smelled of tuberose.
His right hand was drawing something unknown on a light pink light screen. From time to time he frowned and whispered something.
Next to him was an unopened and half-drinked jar of Ice Mist Fruit Wine.
When Chu Anzhi saw this scene, she just stepped into the yard and silently took it back.
"Xiao Zhi?"
Feng Wuhen, who was hit behind him, looked at the somewhat serious Chu Anzhi with some confusion.
"Gui Ya is at work."
Feng Wuhen followed Chu Anzhi's gaze and was silent for a moment, then slowly said: "Work is work, why do you want to quit?"
"He frowned."
Feng Wuhen:?
